changelog:
jedToolKit 27.0.1 adds all-new jedAI Widgets for your Home Screen.

• jedAI Widgets: View recent conversations, titles, and timestamps directly from the Home Screen with adaptive layouts.
• Visual Redesign: Clean card-style rows, tinted badges, and an expanded title style.
• Live Sync: Automatic real-time updates for new, updated, or deleted chats.
• Improved Troubleshooting: Clearer error guidance for sync, installation, and sideloading issues.

This update is recommended for all users.
